dsn.description: The DSN for the Sentry SDK: `SENTRY_LARAVEL_DSN`.

secret.description: The key itself, shown this once.

problems.description:
What keeps Logdock from taking data: `database_unavailable`,
`low_disk`, `writer_stalled`.

key_id.description: The key that was used; `null` for requests no key let in.

skipped.description: Items of kinds Logdock does not keep.

attributes.description: The attributes, flattened (`user.id`), in the order they were sent.

time.description: When it was written, RFC 3339 with microseconds.

next.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

Problem.description: Error body as defined by RFC 9457 (`application/problem+json`).

code.description: Stable, machine-readable identifier the frontend relies on, e.g. `not_found`.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation, if there is more to say than the title.

title.description: Reason phrase of the status code.

allowed_keys.description: When set, only these attribute keys are kept; `user.*` keeps a prefix.

extra_keys.description:
More key fragments whose values are never stored, beyond the built-in
ones (password, token, secret, …).

csrf_token.description: Sent back in `X-CSRF-Token` with every request that changes something.

expires_at.description: When the session ends unless used before.

notify.description:
Who gets e-mail about the project's errors, also people without an
account.

code.description: The code Logdock wrote to its log at the start.

needed.description:
No account exists yet: the first administrator is to be created with
the setup code from Logdock's log.

session.name: __Host-logdock_session
session.description: Set by sign-in or setup. Named `logdock_session` where secure cookies are off.
